modmenu.summaryTranslation.simplechestlo: A simple chest locker for your servers.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.simpleche: A server-side Fabric mod that lets players lock containers and grant access to others. Supports chest labels, trusts, container indices for remote management, an in-game GUI menu, cross-dimension administration, and modded containers. The optional client-side overlay (lock icons + label) requires the mod on the client too.
